verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented telemetry or diagnostic-data opt-out. The only privacy-adjacent item covers advertising preferences on free accounts, which is a different control from usage tracking and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
